title: Transfer a vessel registration
summary: Learn how to transfer a vessel registration into your name after purchasing a vessel.
intro:
When you buy a vessel, you need to transfer its registration into your name within 14 days of the date of purchase.

If the registered vessel owner has died, see Transfer a vessel registration due to the death of the registered operator.
who_can_apply: You must have purchased a vessel and need to transfer its registration into your name.
what_you_need: If the certificate lacks a HIN on the front, a HIN (Boatcode) certificate is required (find a boatcode agent to get the vessel inspected)
A completed Application for Transfer of Vessel Registration – PDF
Supporting documents to prove acquisition of the vessel
If the registration certificate sections are incomplete, additional supporting documents are needed.

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to make an appointment at a Service NSW Centre.
Lodge your transfer documentation in person at your selected service centre.

faqs.q: What is the timeframe for transferring a vessel registration?
faqs.a: You must transfer the registration into your name within 14 days of the date of purchase.

faqs.q: What should I do if the registered owner has died?
faqs.a: See the section on Transfer a vessel registration due to the death of the registered operator.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to transfer the registration?
faqs.a: You need your proof of identity, the certificate of registration, your payment, a completed Application for Transfer of Vessel Registration – PDF, supporting documents to prove acquisition of the vessel, and potentially a HIN (Boatcode) certificate.
